hero.title: Look up anything, on {accent}
hero.popupLead: Paste an address, transaction, block or name. Web3Lens finds its chain among {count}.
hero.appLead: Paste an address, transaction, block or name. Web3Lens recognises it, checks it and shows you the answer.

scan.nothingBody: No addresses, transaction hashes or names on this page. Select text and right-click to look it up instead.
scan.cantReadBody: {error}. Browser pages (settings, extension stores, new tabs) can’t be scanned.
scan.bannerBody: Reads the visible text of this tab once, when you open this tab. Nothing is sent anywhere.

unit-converter.title: Unit converter
unit-converter.short: wei · gwei · ETH, sats · BTC, any decimals
unit-converter.description: Convert between wei, gwei and ether, satoshis and bitcoin, lamports and SOL, or any token decimals, exactly (no rounding).

address-validator.title: Address validator
address-validator.description: Check whether an address is valid for its chain: EIP-55 checksums, base58check, bech32, CashAddr, SS58, Stellar and TON, plus the OFAC sanctions snapshot.

hex-converter.title: Hex, text and hashes
hex-converter.description: Convert hex to decimal and back, text to hex, read int256 words, and hash text or bytes with keccak256 and SHA-256 (with function selectors).

timestamp-converter.title: Timestamp converter
timestamp-converter.description: Convert Unix timestamps (seconds, milliseconds, hex block timestamps) to dates in UTC and your time zone, and dates back to timestamps.

gas-calculator.title: Gas and fee calculator
gas-calculator.short: EIP-1559 fees with live gas prices
gas-calculator.description: Work out transaction fees from gas limit, base fee and tip, with live gas prices for 11 EVM chains and Bitcoin fee rates.

abi-decoder.title: Calldata and ABI decoder
abi-decoder.description: Decode Ethereum calldata with a contract ABI, a function signature or the built-in list of common functions, and encode calls from a signature.

transaction-decoder.title: Raw transaction decoder
transaction-decoder.description: Decode a signed raw EVM transaction (legacy, EIP-1559, blob, EIP-7702) locally and recover the sender, without broadcasting it.

gas.offlineBody: Live gas needs an online lookup. Turn on online lookups in settings, or use the fee calculator with your own numbers.
gas.source: Public RPCs, mempool.space, CoinGecko · fetched {time} UTC. Rollups add an L1 data fee.
gas.head: Live fees · {count} EVM chains and Bitcoin

saved.filterPlaceholder: Filter by label, address or note
saved.emptyBody: Press Save after a search to keep an address or transaction here with a label and notes. Saved items stay in this browser.
saved.manageTitle: Edit labels and notes, export, import or share

settings.privacyBody: Balances, transactions, risk checks and live gas are fetched from {host} when you ask. Turn off to keep everything in the browser: detection, checksums, explorer links, tools and the bundled OFAC snapshot still work.
settings.privacyNote: The extension has no host permissions and only reads a page when you open the popup’s “Scan page” tab on it.
settings.dataBody: Everything is in this browser’s extension storage.

api.badAnswer: Web3Lens sent an answer this version of the extension can’t read. Explorer links and local checks still work; updating the extension should fix it.
api.timeout: Web3Lens took too long to answer. Try again in a moment; explorer links and local checks still work.
api.unreachable: Web3Lens could not be reached. Check your connection.

api.serviceDown: The Web3Lens lookup service is unavailable right now (HTTP {status}). Explorer links and local checks still work.

result.hiddenTokens: {count} token(s) hidden: flagged as spam by the indexer, or with no name or symbol. Don't interact with tokens you didn't expect.
result.knownOnly: Only {count} well-known tokens were checked (no free token index covers {chain}); other holdings aren't shown.
result.name: Name
result.unconfirmed: {count} unconfirmed transaction(s) pending, not included above.

risk.title: Risk checks
risk.signals: {count} risk signal(s) found. Don't send funds or sign anything without checking.

risk.notChecked: not checked: the free sources cover EVM chains only
risk.noApprovals: No active approvals found in the events scanned.
risk.capped: Log search hit its limit: older approvals may be missing.

validator.hint: A valid checksum means it was copied correctly, not that it is trustworthy.

savedPage.label: Label

note.badChecksum: The checksum does not match. The value may contain a typo; check it before sending funds.
note.privateKey: This looks like a private key. Anyone who has it controls the funds. Web3Lens will not search it.
note.stellarSecret: This is a Stellar secret key. Anyone who has it controls the account. Web3Lens will not search it.
note.recoveryPhrase: This looks like a wallet recovery phrase. Anyone who has it controls the wallet. Web3Lens will not search it; never paste it into a website.
note.bech32Unknown: A valid bech32 address for "{hrp}", a network Web3Lens doesn't list yet.
note.versionByte: Version byte {byte} isn't one Web3Lens recognises.
